description: Cameras for the painted-backdrop cutscene. Constraint: every camera sits at z >= 2 and looks toward -Z, because the painted backdrop (at world z=-40) is the only 'sky'. Reverse-angles would shoot into empty procedural sky and are therefore avoided. Character positions: Aristotle starts (1, 0, -1) then walks to (0, 0, -3). NoTail starts (-2, 0, -3), walks to (-1.5, 0, -2) after door opens.

cameras.name: CAM_01_Establishing
cameras.description: Wide-right, Aristotle at ~30% frame width. Painted outpost + wreckage read as environment.

cameras.name: CAM_02_GlideBehind
cameras.description: 3/4 behind-and-above Aristotle as he walks forward. Look-at is 3m past his walk target so the camera glides along the walk direction.

cameras.name: CAM_03_OverShoulder
cameras.description: Tight over Aristotle's right shoulder (he's at (0,0,-3) after walking). Painted doorway dominates frame.

cameras.name: CAM_04_SideSlide
cameras.description: Camera slides to stage-right as NoTail emerges. Frames both characters from the audience side.

cameras.name: CAM_05_NoTailClose
cameras.description: Close on NoTail from slightly stage-right. Camera is ~4.7m away from her walked position.

cameras.name: CAM_06_TwoShot
cameras.description: Medium two-shot. Aristotle right, NoTail left, backdrop framing both.

cameras.name: CAM_07_AristotleClose
cameras.description: Close on Aristotle from stage-right. Still facing -Z (backdrop in frame). This is a same-side close, not a true reverse — painted backdrop can't support a 180-deg reverse.
